page.overview:
Who is Chef Spore?

Chef Spore is a Mushroom person from the Super Mario Bros. comic series.

Appearing in the issue "Bowser Knows Best," Chef Spore is an uptight cook who does not want Princess Toadstool using the kitchen to cook her father a cake. Eventually, he is taken out of the kitchen by Mario and Toad after begging Princess Toadstool to stop baking. He is also one of the only Toads in the Nintendo Comics System other than Toad himself to look like the Toads from the games, as opposed to an anthropomorphic Super Mushroom.
